provenance: distilled from the liquid study's recorded d1-2B sea-state trace (results/exp_c_trace_d1-2B.json, recorded on the Thor 2026-10-31, section 4.3): 240 ticks, 6 trials x 40 steps, one decision per tick. This is the column the gate consumes — the probability vector, the model's confidence, and the recorded ground truth (shown = what the state presented, truth = the true condition; with probability 0.35 the decoy was presented). The raw traces stay gitignored; this distillation is committed so the replay test runs anywhere.
